review.all_selected_triplets: raw metadata, exact symbolic controls, action sets, target visibility, bbox thresholds and image signals checked
review.primary_triplets: agent visual review of every selected causal-state unit primary
review.inspection: Every candidate shown in matched A/C/N contact sheets: target crops for the original cohort, full frames for fresh television candidates. All faucet candidates additionally shown as full frames; flagged cases re-inspected using full frames and native target crops. Context and action labels checked for each originating unit.

blockers.isFilledWithLiquid: Native filling also changes fillLiquid; Table 4 Boolean-only rule does not authorize this extra change.
blockers.isSliced: Native slicing creates descendants and changes reciprocal containment; original three tiers do not authorize topology changes.
blockers.isUsedUp: AI2-THOR 5.0.0 reports constant false through raw metadata accessor; trace-derived extension is not raw predicate certification.
blockers.human_review_provenance: The user requested a simulated manual process. Full triplet proxy review is complete; this is agent review, not evidence of actual human review in the manuscript.

excluded_legacy_unit.reason: Side view of television hides on/off display; weak primary causal visual signal. Retained in extended/archive only.

interpretation: A reviewed candidate collection at paper scale where possible, not the original experimental cohort or a claim of seven-predicate compliance.

visual_exclusions.preservation: Excluded observations remain in extended/archive; no archived data removed.
